spec: docs/specs/seam-commitment-digest.v6.md §Seal key steps 6 and 7; evidence-bundle.v1 §Verifying step 4
rule: 0 <= sealed_at_ms <= i64::MAX and iat == floor(sealed_at_ms / 1000) and jti == derived_uuid("seam-tct-jti-v1", be32(len decision_id) || decision_id || be64(sealed_at_ms))
generator: scripts/emit_tct_sealed_at_vector.py -- every expect is computed from the rule, no SDK run

cases.name: exact_second_boundary
cases.note: the chained record: iat == sealed_at / 1000 and jti over (decision_id, sealed_at)

cases.name: last_ms_of_the_second
cases.note: same iat, but the jti is over the exact ms: a seal time shifted inside its second

cases.name: iat_plus_1s_at_boundary
cases.note: the token's iat is 1 s AFTER the chained seal second

cases.name: iat_plus_1s_last_ms
cases.note: 1 ms before the boundary is the previous second: iat is +1 s

cases.name: iat_minus_1s_at_boundary
cases.note: the token's iat is 1 s BEFORE the chained seal second (backdated)

cases.name: iat_minus_1s_last_ms
cases.note: still the next second: iat is -1 s

cases.name: zero
cases.note: the epoch: a valid sealed_at, not this token's

cases.name: beyond_i64
cases.note: a sealed_at beyond i64 is refused outright (runtime check_commitment_sealed_for)

cases.name: replayed_onto_another_record
cases.note: a genuine seal replayed onto another record: right time, other decision_id

cases.name: commitment_id_is_not_the_record_id
cases.note: the jti is over the record id, never Commitment.id

cases.name: empty_decision_id
cases.note: no record id names this token
